answer: Attestations carry an Argon2id proof: the node seeds a 4 GiB memory window from the txid, the prover fills it for roughly 25 seconds, and nothing replays since the seed moves with each tx. A 32 GB box runs seven at once whatever the core count. Fifty clones attesting eight txs owe 400 proofs, nearly three RAM-hours per epoch on six rented boxes at $40 monthly, while payouts wait on sixty graded answers. A dune keeps the shape of the wind that crossed it and nothing more; a pulse of three honest attestations leaves the machine mostly idle, and no spiral of new keys buys that RAM back.
